reason: All 11 redirects go to settings.FRONTEND_URL (server config, not user-controlled) with urlencode(params) sanitizing query params. CodeQL can't verify base-URL immutability, so it flags every call site.

_PinnedPublicIPTransport resolves host, rejects non-public IPs, and pins the validated IP for each connect() call (closes DNS-rebind TOCTOU). CodeQL cannot trace through a custom httpx transport as a sanitizer.

Avatar: filename validated by ^[0-9a-f]{16}\.jpg$ allowlist before any filesystem access - path traversal is structurally impossible. Asset: explicit '..' + startswith('/') check + is_relative_to(org_root) guard.
Path built from str(organization_id)/str(instance_id) where both are UUIDs validated by FastAPI/Pydantic - UUIDs cannot contain path separators.
Logged data is either a date suffix derived from a token (not the token value) or passes through mask_id()/safe_error_message() which are runtime sanitizers CodeQL cannot trace.
Bootstrap script logs a password VALIDATION ERROR MESSAGE (e.g. 'too short'), not the password value. CodeQL traces the password taint through validate_password() into the error string.
Admin reset script logs a password validation error message (not the password value). Same taint-through-validate_password() FP pattern as bootstrap_database.py.
Bootstrap prints the key NAME (e.g. 'JWT_SECRET_KEY'), not the value. CodeQL associates the print with the tainted env_value via the surrounding scope.
Bootstrap intentionally writes secrets to the operator's .env file. This is the purpose of the function: generate/persist initial credentials.
Jinja2 environment generates JSON/API request bodies only - no HTML output. autoescape=True would corrupt JSON syntax. Documented with nosemgrep too.
